summary: Fixed QA-1 only. (1) The built bundles are now smaller than v1.7.0's, measured with rollup -c on both trees (HEAD via git archive in scratch, working tree): dist/index.js 122706 -> 122639 bytes and dist/index.esm.js 122244 -> 122171 bytes. To get there I removed the MenuButton wrapper component and render the hamburger, the rail toggle and the search input through one module-scope `const h = React.createElement` alias, one line per call (this also drops an extra component invocation per render); I compacted the off-state term-reset effect to a single-line dispatch; and I condensed three verbose comments in the same file to one line each (the reset-effect comment plus two unrelated ones) because Rollup keeps source comments and line breaks in the bundle - comments only, no behaviour or markup change anywhere. (2) The limit is now enforced: a new test reads dist/index.js and dist/index.esm.js and fails if either exceeds the v1.7.0 sizes, so a future growth is caught. Nothing else changed this round: search stays opt-in with searchEnabled default false, the off-state term reset, types, package version 2.0.0, the breaking-changes entry and the docs are untouched. Checks run: npx tsc --noEmit clean; SidekickMenu.test.tsx 59/59; npm run build passes; full suite 215 passed with only the two pre-existing Styles/SidekickMenu.theme.test.ts CRLF failures, which fail identically on a pristine HEAD checkout.
